The formula for slope (m) in simple linear regression:
m = Σ((x - x̄)(y - ȳ)) / Σ((x - x̄)²)

And intercept (b):
b = ȳ - m * x̄

WITH daily_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        DATE(order_purchase_timestamp) as order_date,
        SUM(payment_value) as daily_sales
    FROM orders
    JOIN order_payments ON orders.order_id = order_payments.order_id
    JOIN order_items ON orders.order_id = order_items.order_id
    JOIN products ON order_items.product_id = products.product_id
    JOIN product_category_name_translation ON products.product_category_name = product_category_name_translation.product_category_name
    WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01'

),
with_idx AS (
    SELECT 
        order_date,
        daily_sales,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY order_date) as day_idx
    FROM daily_sales
),
regression AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG(daily_sales) as mean_y,
        AVG(day_idx) as mean_x,
        SUM((day_idx - AVG(day_idx)) * (daily_sales - AVG(daily_sales))) / 
            SUM(POWER(day_idx - AVG(day_idx), 2)) as slope
    FROM with_idx
)

FROM regression
